task: Prevent story_advance DONE from writing terminal DONE metadata before the main merge target is known to be safe and usable.
outcome: User transcript after the fix: running lattice story_advance --storyId=B-xxxx --phase=DONE from a story worktree either succeeds with the normal DONE checklist plus merge/cleanup lines, or fails before the phase changes with text like Cannot enter DONE: main worktree is unavailable or not on main; phase remains TEST; cd "<actual-main-worktree>" and retry/recover. The user can immediately see which checkout owns main and no longer has to repair a partial-DONE story created by the command itself.
facts: transition-orchestrator currently runs runDonePreMergeGate before actor.send/writeStory, but applyDoneMergeEffects still performs the real merge after phase=DONE is persisted.

applyDoneMergeEffects resolves mainRepoRoot from the story worktree and then runs git merge on that checkout; if that checkout is not available or not a usable main checkout, the story can already be terminal.
done_recover currently resolves mainRepoRoot but its refusal/hint text does not reliably point to the actual registered main worktree path in multi-worktree situations.
INIT reviewers flagged the need to separate production behavior (preflight fail-before-write) from regression proof and to cover the normal no-extra-hint path.
constraints: Do not remove existing normal DONE auto-merge behavior when main is available and clean.
Any preflight failure must happen before actor.send and before store.writeStory persists phase=DONE.
Do not tell users to merge into a checkout whose current branch is not main.
Keep the change local to DONE merge/recovery surfaces and focused regression coverage.
Use Lattice CLI commands for story/checklist/evidence metadata; do not edit story JSON directly.
unknowns: Whether existing helper coverage can simulate a main checkout held/unavailable without destructive merges into the developer main.
Whether the final code needs a new shared main-worktree resolver in partial-done-recovery or can reuse existing listRegisteredWorktrees plus resolveMainRepoRoot.
Whether process-fact registry needs a new entry or existing story_advance L4 preflight coverage is sufficient; verify with process contract.
touchpoints: packages/main/src/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.ts or a focused DONE/recovery smoke task
